parsed.summary: The PR addresses a specific bug but introduces a non-minimal change and lacks sufficient tests.

issues.description: The change introduces a non-minimal change by adding an `else` block that handles cases where `ax.axis` is not a dictionary. This may not be the most appropriate solution and could lead to unexpected behavior in other scenarios.
The PR does not include any new tests to verify the fix. Without tests, there is no assurance that the change will not regress in the future.
